items.item_text: Board Certified or Board Eligible in Geriatric Psychiatry

UCLA Health is seeking a Geriatric Psychiatrist to support our outpatient practices across West Los Angeles. This role is part of UCLA Behavioral Health Associates, offering outpatient psychiatry opportunities within our primary care–based collaborative mental health program.

At UCLA Health, you will be co-located within primary care practices, providing both individualized and team-based patient care. Our Behavioral Health providers—including psychiatrists and therapists—deliver short-term, evidence-based treatments and consultative services. You will enjoy the clinical acuity and continuity that primary care–referred patients offer, while using your expertise to advance mental health care for UCLA’s aging patient population.
We offer a variety of innovative care delivery models, including an advanced behavioral health screening platform, iCBT, telehealth, ongoing case conferences, and continuing education opportunities.
Opportunity to support UCLA Health’s mission of delivering leading-edge, patient-centered care
Build meaningful patient relationships while advancing your career at one of the nation’s top academic health systems
Comfortable with telemedicine and collaborative care models

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
At UCLA Health, your skills, expertise, and passion define our outstanding care. Discover all UCan achieve in your physician practice at UCLA Health.
